cells.tense: The strength now moves out and comes back in the same steady breath.
cells.act: choose which star to steer by and steer
cells.ask: Pick one aim for the next ten minutes and move toward it without surveying the room. Go the whole stretch before you decide whether it was right.
cells.core:
You have an arrangement where carrying someone else does not hollow you out. What goes out comes back, the give and take stays roughly level, and the care keeps its quality because you are not deciding it from dread.

What holds this up is that you stay awake to the moment — how much, when, whether the other person is open right now. That is not coldness; that is attention. What comes next is a heading. Not only being the one who can hold things up, but knowing which way you are facing while you do it. The low pull under all this is a genuine wanting, and it sharpens when what you carry is clean.

When helping starts costing you your bones, the measure has tilted. That is a signal to adjust, not a verdict.
cells.sheetLine: You hold things up without losing yourself. Keep the measure true.

cells.tense: A future is being run that cannot be written in yet.
cells.act: do the fair thing where no one will see
cells.ask: Do one unglamorous fair thing tonight with nobody aware of it. Do it once, then put it out of your mind entirely.
cells.core:
You are bracing so hard for a future you cannot see that you are bolting the present shut. Support is steady when it moves from a quiet, natural sense of what is right. Right now it is not moving; it is being forced. You are checking crates against a scale that does not exist yet, and your hands are clenched around whatever might slip.

That is not open-handedness, it is defense. The care you are trying to secure is getting squeezed out of reach. What you actually want underneath is exchange that flows, not tallying that keeps starting up again. So find something plainly right, do it, and then let the counting stop. When you catch yourself auditing, ask whose scale this is. The strength loosens when it is not being tested at the gate.
cells.sheetLine: You can't brace a future that hasn't happened. Let the now be true.

cells.tense: You are still at a door you already walked through.
cells.act: engage the hard part on purpose and see what holds
cells.ask: Sit with the task you keep sliding past for ten minutes, clumsily. Let it show you what is actually there without asking it for anything.
cells.core:
The support went hollow. What used to be a shared resource now feels like a closed box you cannot open, and you are standing where it used to be, wondering why it is cold. Strength ran out of places to go and just pooled.

This is not a failure of your generosity. It is that you gave everything you had and did not keep a tap for yourself. The fix is not to force more out — that would empty you further. Instead, turn to the piece you have been sidestepping and handle it directly. Not for anyone else. For the practice of it. See what holds when nothing is watching. Ease might come in small steps, and you will know it by the release, not the applause.
cells.sheetLine: You still help. But you left the room. Come back to the work.

cells.tense: You are holding the pen down in a room where you are still writing.
cells.act: decide the heading from what you want, not from logic
cells.ask: For the next small choice today, follow what you want instead of what reasons best. Notice that you made the call yourself once it is done.
cells.core:
Something in you is already steering the flow of help, but you are calling it 'what needs to happen' and stepping out of the frame. The strength that shares by measure is being pointed by someone, and that someone is you.

The generosity is real. What is off is subtle: you keep telling it that it is just circumstance. The truth is that you are deciding which needs are yours to carry. That is choosing, not accident. To take it back, do not thrash around trying to control more. Instead, sit still and ask what you actually want to move toward. The call is already being made at a level you are not watching. Bring it into the light, and the same action becomes chosen instead of automatic. Then the strength can glow from genuine development, not hidden drift.
cells.sheetLine: You're making the call. Start saying so.
